subject: SI Onboarding Intake + 3-day Bootcamp — proposed plan
messages:
From: Ethan Walker <ethan@consultsprint.io>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@consultsprint.io>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SI onboarding: intake + 3-day bootcamp proposal

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the intro over the last few weeks — we saw a lot of product-market fit signals with two pilot prospects and want to get our delivery teams certified on Redwood fundamentals.

High-level ask: can Redwood run a short onboarding + enablement bootcamp for ConsultSprint's SI delivery and pre-sales teams? Proposed scope:
- Day 0 (intake): 90m intake call to align on top 3 customer patterns, infra constraints, and PII handling requirements
- Day 1 (hands-on): deployment patterns (hosted/dedicated/private), runtime ops, and observability labs
- Day 2 (integration): SDK usage, function calling, and embedding-based search integration labs
- Day 3 (certification): joint runbook exercise and mutual action plan

Attached: SI_Bootcamp_ask.pdf and a short partner_profile.xlsx (team sizes, regions). Goals: 1) certified delivery playbook, 2) 2-week POC template, 3) joint sales collateral.

We are targeting week of June 14 — flexible if you have capacity earlier. Let us know next steps and any intake form you prefer.

Thanks,
Ethan
Head of Strategic Delivery
ConsultSprint

Attachment stubs: SI_Bootcamp_ask.pdf (pdf), partner_profile.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Walker <ethan@consultsprint.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SI onboarding: intake + 3-day bootcamp proposal

Thanks Ethan — this is great, and happy to run this workshop. Quick notes and next steps: 

1) Intake: we have a short online intake survey that captures customer archetypes, compliance needs, and preferred cloud topology. I'll send the link in a follow-up and ask you to get it filled by your L3 delivery lead.

2) Bootcamp format: we prefer a tightly scripted 3-day agenda with pre-read + hands-on sandbox per participant. Attached: Redwood_onboard_checklist.xlsx and Bootcamp_Module_Outlines.pdf — these show required attendee roles, lab access, and prerequisites.

3) Roles: Marissa will lead the delivery labs (runtime & ops), Jordan will own SDK/embedding modules and joint sales positioning.

4) Logistics: can you confirm number of attendees and whether you need a private VPC sandbox or if hosted sandboxes are acceptable? Also flag any legal/SOC2 data handling constraints now — that affects the MOU draft.

If June 14 works for you, we'll reserve trainer slots and draft an MOU for signature. My calendar is open next Tue/Thu for a 30-min intake to finalize objectives.

Best,
Alex
Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Alex — looping in a few practicals from the delivery side.

On Fri, May 28, 2026 at 11:03 AM Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Ethan — this is great, and happy to run this workshop. Quick notes and next steps: 
>
> 1) Intake: we have a short online intake survey that captures customer archetypes, compliance needs, and preferred cloud topology. I'll send the link in a follow-up and ask you to get it filled by your L3 delivery lead.

Suggested additions to the checklist:
- Pre-populate a POC dataset example for the embedding lab (redact PII)
- Confirm expected RPS/seq-length for anticipated workloads so we size Dedicated pool appropriately during labs
- Ask for a prioritized list of 3 customer reference use-cases to focus the runbook exercise

Also — for hands-on labs we prefer cohorts of 8-12 engineers. If ConsultSprint expects 20+ attendees, we should split into parallel labs with a 1:6 trainer ratio.

I can draft a 1-page POC scope and a mutual action plan (MAP) template for signatures; that will make it easier for procurement to approve.

Marissa
Senior Technical Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
